name: sm8750
notes: soc_id is the Android SoC ID reported by /sys/devices/soc0/soc_id; it is a different numbering scheme and is never passed to the compiler.

QAIRT's own compile default is v79/soc_model 69, i.e. this exact tuple, so a resolved-value check cannot distinguish this target from an SDK fallback. The empty-device-config guard is what covers that.
